clauses.quote: (1) Währung; Stückelung. Diese Serie der Schuldverschreibungen (die "Schuldverschreibungen") der BASF SE ("BASF" oder die "Emittentin") wird in Euro (EUR) (die "festgelegte Währung") im Gesamtnennbetrag   (vorbehaltlich § 1 Absatz (4)) von EUR 500.000.000 (in Worten: EUR fünfhundert Millionen) in einer Stückelung von EUR 100.000 (die "festgelegte Stückelung") begeben.
clauses.effect_explanation: These issue amount, bearer form and holder provisions alone confer no uncompensated principal-loss or compulsory-conversion authority. They do not establish an actual balance, ownership or procedural standing.

amount_reading.reading: This series of notes of BASF SE (BASF or the issuer) is issued in euro with an aggregate principal amount of EUR 500,000,000 (EUR five hundred million), subject to section 1(4), in denominations of EUR 100,000.
amount_reading.qualification: The stated issue amount is qualified by the selected NGN records provisions. It does not establish the represented balance on another date, actual issuance, payment, purchase, cancellation or any persons holding.
